payload.title: Expose claimId and assignee in list --json so fencing tokens are retrievable
payload.body: tasks claim prints the claim_id fencing token once, but list --json only returns id/title/priority/tags/body/blocked — not claimId or assignee. So an agent that didn't save the token can't run heartbeat --claim or complete --claim (the fencing flows shipped in expose-and-fence-the-heartbeat-via-the-cli and the complete/release/update fencing P2). Add claimId + assignee + leaseExpiresAt to the git-native list --json projection (and consider a tasks show <id> --json) so a long-running agent can re-derive its own token mid-session. The tasks-claims log already holds these (not secret), so exposing them to the owner is safe. Surfaced implementing the heartbeat CLI command.
